```{r}
#pre-tx cortical seed
rsFC_25 <- read.csv("~/SMART/corticalrsfc/pre-tx/bilateral_25_to_cortex_fc.csv")
rsFC_PeEC <- read.csv("~/SMART/corticalrsfc/pre-tx/bilateral_PeEc_EC_H_PreS_to_cortex_fc.csv")
rsFC_a24p32 <- read.csv("~/SMART/corticalrsfc/pre-tx/bilateral_a24_p32_to_cortex_fc.csv")
rsFC_p24a32pr <- read.csv("~/SMART/corticalrsfc/pre-tx/bilateral_p24_a32pr_to_cortex_fc.csv")

#post-tx cortical seed
postrsFC_25 <- read.csv("~/SMART/corticalrsfc/post-tx/ses02_bilateral_25_to_cortex_fc.csv")
postrsFC_PeEC <- read.csv("~/SMART/corticalrsfc/post-tx/ses02_bilateral_PeEc_EC_H_PreS_to_cortex_fc.csv")
postrsFC_a24p32 <- read.csv("~/SMART/corticalrsfc/post-tx/ses02_bilateral_a24_p32_to_cortex_fc.csv")
postrsFC_p24a32pr <- read.csv("~/SMART/corticalrsfc/post-tx/ses02_bilateral_p24_a32pr_to_cortex_fc.csv")

smart_trtassign <- read.csv("~/SMART/cortical thickness/PRT/trt_assignment_090425.csv")
smart_trt <- read.csv("~/SMART/cortical thickness/PRT/SMARTDataTx_9.4.25.csv")
smart_madrs <- read.csv("~/Desktop/SMART/SMART_baseline_demog_MADRS.csv")
smart_demog <- read.csv("~/SMART/SMART_Demog.csv")

#combine data
smart_prepostrsfc_25 <- bind_rows(rsFC_25 %>% mutate(timepoint = "pre"),
  postrsFC_25 %>% mutate(timepoint = "post")) %>%
  filter(mean_fd != 0) %>% 
  left_join(SMART_NEO %>% select(study_id, age, sex), by = "study_id")

smart_prepostrsfc_PeEC <- bind_rows(rsFC_PeEC %>% mutate(timepoint = "pre"),
  postrsFC_PeEC %>% mutate(timepoint = "post")) %>%
  filter(mean_fd != 0) %>% 
  left_join(SMART_NEO %>% select(study_id, age, sex), by = "study_id")

smart_prepostrsfc_a24p32 <- bind_rows(rsFC_a24p32 %>% mutate(timepoint = "pre"),
  postrsFC_a24p32 %>% mutate(timepoint = "post")) %>%
  filter(mean_fd != 0) %>% 
  left_join(SMART_NEO %>% select(study_id, age, sex), by = "study_id")

smart_prepostrsfc_p24a32pr <- bind_rows(rsFC_p24a32pr %>% mutate(timepoint = "pre"),
  postrsFC_p24a32pr %>% mutate(timepoint = "post")) %>%
  filter(mean_fd != 0) %>% 
  left_join(SMART_NEO %>% select(study_id, age, sex), by = "study_id")

smart_trt_clean <- smart_trt %>%
  mutate(actual_treatment = case_when(str_detect(str_to_upper(Medication), "BUP") ~ "BUP",
                                      str_detect(str_to_upper(Medication), "SER") ~ "SER", TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         actual_treatment = factor(actual_treatment)) %>%
  select(study_id, actual_treatment, Medication, Dose)

smart_trtassign_clean <- smart_trtassign %>%
  mutate(marker_treatment = case_when(BUP == 1 & SER == 0 ~ "BUP", BUP == 0 & SER == 1 ~ "SER", BUP == 1 & SER == 1 ~ "BOTH", BUP == 0 & SER == 0 ~ "NEITHER", TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    marker_treatment = factor(marker_treatment)) %>%
  select(study_id, BUP, SER, marker_treatment)

smart_prepost_trt <- smart_madrs %>%
  left_join(smart_trt_clean, by = "study_id") %>%
  left_join(smart_trtassign_clean, by = "study_id") %>%
  mutate(marker_matched = case_when(marker_treatment == "BUP" & actual_treatment == "BUP" ~ "matched",
      marker_treatment == "SER" & actual_treatment == "SER" ~ "matched",
      marker_treatment %in% c("BOTH", "NEITHER") ~ NA_character_,
      is.na(marker_treatment) | is.na(actual_treatment) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ "not_matched"),
    marker_matched = factor(marker_matched, levels = c("not_matched", "matched")),
    actual_treatment = factor(actual_treatment),
    marker_treatment = factor(marker_treatment))%>% 
  left_join(SMART_NEO %>% select(study_id, age, sex), by = "study_id")
```

#clean madrs
```{r}
# 1. Prepare data and calculate clinical outcomes
smart_prepost_trt <- smart_prepost_trt %>%
  filter(!is.na(MADRS_w0)) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_change = (MADRS_w0 - MADRS_w8) / MADRS_w0 * 100,
    responder_status = factor(if_else(percent_change >= 50, "Responder", "Non-Responder"),
                              levels = c("Non-Responder", "Responder")),
    remission_status = factor(if_else(MADRS_w8 <= 10, "Remitter", "Non-Remitter"),
                              levels = c("Non-Remitter", "Remitter")),
    SHAPS_percent_change = (SHAPS_s1 - SHAPS_s9) / SHAPS_s1 * 100)

# 2. Baseline descriptive statistics and clinical outcomes
smart_prepost_trt %>%
  summarise(
    MADRS_mean = mean(MADRS_w0),
    MADRS_sd = sd(MADRS_w0),
    SHAPS_mean = mean(SHAPS_s3, na.rm = TRUE),
    SHAPS_sd = sd(SHAPS_s3, na.rm = TRUE),
    N_week8 = sum(!is.na(MADRS_w8)))

responder_counts <- smart_prepost_trt %>%
  count(responder_status) %>% filter(!is.na(responder_status))

remission_counts <- smart_prepost_trt %>%
  count(remission_status) %>% filter(!is.na(remission_status))

smart_prepost_trt %>% count(marker_treatment, actual_treatment)

# 3. MADRS change by marker and treatment group
madrs_prs_table <- smart_prepost_trt %>%
  mutate(
    marker = toupper(trimws(marker_treatment)),
    treatment = toupper(trimws(actual_treatment)),
    treatment = recode(treatment, BUPROPION = "BUP", SERTRALINE = "SER"),
    marker_label = recode(marker,
      BOTH = "Bupropion +/Sertraline +",
      BUP = "Bupropion +/Sertraline -",
      SER = "Bupropion -/Sertraline +",
      NEITHER = "Bupropion -/Sertraline -",
      .default = NA_character_),
    arm_group = paste(marker_label, "and", treatment, "treatment"),
    MADRS_change = as.numeric(MADRS_w8) - as.numeric(MADRS_w0)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(marker_label), treatment %in% c("BUP", "SER"),
         !is.na(MADRS_change)) %>%
  distinct(study_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(arm_group) %>%
  summarise(number_analyzed = n(),
    mean_change = round(mean(MADRS_change), 2),
    standard_deviation = round(sd(MADRS_change), 2),
    .groups = "drop")

madrs_prs_table

# 4. Baseline MADRS severity among Week 8 completers
severity_summary <- smart_prepost_trt %>%
  filter(!is.na(MADRS_w8)) %>%

    MADRS_w0 <= 6 ~ "Normal/Minimal",
    MADRS_w0 <= 19 ~ "Mild",
    MADRS_w0 <= 34 ~ "Moderate",

smart_prepost_trt %>%
  filter(!is.na(MADRS_w8)) %>%

responder_info <- smart_madrs %>%
  filter(!is.na(MADRS_w0), !is.na(MADRS_w8)) %>%
  mutate(percent_change = (MADRS_w0 - MADRS_w8) / MADRS_w0 * 100,
    responder_status = if_else(percent_change >= 50, "Responder", "Non-Responder"),

remission_info <- smart_madrs %>%
  filter(!is.na(MADRS_w0), !is.na(MADRS_w8)) %>%
  mutate(percent_change = (MADRS_w0 - MADRS_w8) / MADRS_w0 * 100,
    remission_status = if_else(MADRS_w8 <= 10, "Remitter","Non-Remitter"),
    remission_status = factor(remission_status, levels = c("Non-Remitter", "Remitter"))) %>%
  select(study_id, MADRS_w0, MADRS_w8, percent_change, remission_status) %>%
  distinct(study_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

#demographics table
```{r}
# 1. Merge and prepare demographic data
demog_data <- smart_prepost_trt %>%
  filter(!is.na(responder_status)) %>%
  distinct(study_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(study_id, age, sex, MADRS_w0, SHAPS_s1, responder_status, remission_status) %>%
  left_join(smart_scid %>% distinct(study_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
              select(study_id, age_of_onset, number_of_episodes), by = "study_id") %>%
  left_join(smart_demog %>% distinct(record_id, .keep_all = TRUE),
            by = c("study_id" = "record_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    Employed = case_when(demog_emp_latn_adapted %in% 0:1 ~ 1,
                         demog_emp_latn_adapted == 2 ~ 0),
    Hispanic.Latino = na_if(Hispanic.Latino, 2),
    race_count = rowSums(across(c(White, Black.African.American, Asian,
      Native.American, Alaska.Native, Pacific.Islander, Some.other.race),
      ~ .x == 1), na.rm = TRUE),
    Multiracial = case_when(race_count > 1 ~ 1, race_count == 1 ~ 0))

# 2. Formatting functions
mean_sd <- function(x) if (sum(!is.na(x)) < 2) NA_character_ else
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))

n_pct <- function(x, level = 1) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_character_ else
  sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(x == level, na.rm = TRUE),
          100 * mean(x == level, na.rm = TRUE))

race_pct <- function(d, col)
  n_pct(ifelse(d$race_count == 1, d[[col]],
               ifelse(d$race_count > 1, 0, NA)), 1)

# 3. Generate demographic summary
summarize_demog <- function(d) {
  continuous <- c("age", "MADRS_w0", "SHAPS_s1", "age_of_onset",
                  "number_of_episodes", "demog_edu_yr_latn_adapted")
  categorical <- c("Female" = "Female", "Male" = "Male",
                   "Hispanic/Latino" = "Hispanic.Latino",
                   "More than one race" = "Multiracial", "Employed" = "Employed")
  race <- c("White" = "White", "Black/African American" = "Black.African.American",
            "Asian" = "Asian", "Native American" = "Native.American",
            "Alaska Native" = "Alaska.Native", "Pacific Islander" = "Pacific.Islander",
            "Other race" = "Some.other.race")

  tibble(
    Characteristic = c("N", "Age, years", "Baseline MADRS", "Baseline SHAPS",
      "Age of MDD onset, years", "Number of lifetime depressive episodes",
      "Female", "Male", "Hispanic/Latino", names(race),
      "More than one race", "Employed", "Years of education"),
    value = c(
      n_distinct(d$study_id),
      sapply(d[continuous], mean_sd),
      n_pct(d$sex, "Female"), n_pct(d$sex, "Male"),
      n_pct(d$Hispanic.Latino), sapply(race, \(x) race_pct(d, x)),
      n_pct(d$Multiracial), n_pct(d$Employed),
      mean_sd(d$demog_edu_yr_latn_adapted)))}

# 4. APA demographic table by response and remission
apa_demographics <- list(
  Overall = demog_data,
  `Non-Responder` = filter(demog_data, responder_status == "Non-Responder"),
  Responder = filter(demog_data, responder_status == "Responder"),
  `Non-Remitter` = filter(demog_data, remission_status == "Non-Remitter"),
  Remitter = filter(demog_data, remission_status == "Remitter")) %>%
  lapply(summarize_demog) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "Group") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = value)

View(apa_demographics)
```

#side effect supplement table
```{r}
sideeffects_smart <- read.csv("~/SMART/sideeffects_smart.csv")

# Define final analysis sample
sample_ids <- smart_prepost_trt %>%
  filter(!is.na(MADRS_w8)) %>%
  transmute(record_id = as.character(study_id), Medication) %>%
  distinct()

# TESS symptom labels
labels <- list(
  sub_tess_beh_tox = c("Toxic confusional state", "Excitement/agitation", "Depressive affect",
                       "Increased motor activity", "Decreased motor activity", "Insomnia", "Drowsiness"),
  sub_tess_abn = c("Abnormal hematologic", "Abnormal liver", "Abnormal urine"),
  sub_tess_neu = c("Rigidity", "Tremor", "Dystonic symptoms", "Akathisia"),
  sub_tess_auto = c("Dry mouth", "Nasal congestion", "Blurred vision", "Constipation",
                    "Increased salivation", "Sweating", "Nausea/vomiting", "Diarrhea"),
  sub_tess_cardio = c("Hypotension", "Syncope/dizziness", "Tachycardia",
                      "Hypertension", "EKG abnormalities"),
  sub_tess_other = c("Dermatologic", "Weight gain", "Weight loss",
                     "Decreased appetite", "Headache", "Tardive dyskinesia"))

symptom_key <- imap_dfr(labels, ~tibble(
  variable = paste0(.y, "___", seq_along(.x)), side_effect = .x))

# Count each symptom once per participant across weeks 1–8
sideeffects_overall <- sideeffects_smart %>%
  mutate(record_id = as.character(record_id)) %>%
  filter(str_detect(redcap_event_name, "week_[1-8](?![0-9])")) %>%
  inner_join(sample_ids, by = "record_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(symptom_key$variable),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "reported") %>%
  left_join(symptom_key, by = "variable") %>%
  group_by(record_id, Medication, side_effect) %>%
  summarise(reported = any(as.character(reported) == "1", na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Calculate medication-specific incidence
group_N <- sample_ids %>% count(Medication, name = "N")

sideeffects_summary <- sideeffects_overall %>%
  group_by(side_effect, Medication) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(reported), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(group_N, by = "Medication") %>%
  group_by(side_effect) %>%
  filter(sum(n) > 0) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(result = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, 100*n/N)) %>%
  select(side_effect, Medication, result, total) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Medication, values_from = result) %>%
  arrange(desc(total), side_effect) %>%
  select(-total)

View(group_N)
View(sideeffects_summary)

# Create and export Word table
tab <- sideeffects_summary %>%
  rename(`Side Effect` = side_effect) %>%
  select(`Side Effect`, SERTRALINE, BUPROPION)

ft <- flextable(tab) %>%
  set_header_labels(SERTRALINE = "Sertraline",
                    BUPROPION = "Bupropion") %>%
  add_header_row(values = c("", "Medication Received"),
                 colwidths = c(1, 2)) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(j = 2:3, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  autofit()

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("Supplementary Table 1", style = "heading 1") %>%
  body_add_par("Side effects reported during 8 weeks of antidepressant treatment") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft) %>%
  body_add_par("Note. Values are n (%), calculated using the total number of participants in each medication group. Each participant was counted once per symptom, regardless of the number of visits at which it was reported.")

ft
```

#1.if people change in rsfc pre and post
##1.1 25
```{r}
roi_vars_all <- names(smart_prepostrsfc_25) %>%
  purrr::keep(~ grepl("_ROI$", .x)) %>%
  na.omit() %>%as.character()

length(roi_vars_all)
head(roi_vars_all)
tail(roi_vars_all)

roi_vars <- roi_vars_all[
  map_lgl(roi_vars_all, function(roi) {pre_values <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
      filter(timepoint == "pre") %>% pull(all_of(roi))
    post_values <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
      filter(timepoint == "post") %>% pull(all_of(roi))
    pre_has_data <- any(!is.na(pre_values))
    post_has_data <- any(!is.na(post_values))
    pre_has_data & post_has_data})]

roi_vars <- roi_vars[!is.na(roi_vars)]

length(roi_vars_all)
length(roi_vars)

removed_rois <- setdiff(roi_vars_all, roi_vars)

#linear mixed effect model
run_prepost_rsfc_lmer <- function(roi) {
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
    select(study_id, timepoint, age, sex, mean_fd, value = all_of(roi)) %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post")),
      sex = factor(sex),
      age_c = age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_fd_c = mean_fd - mean(mean_fd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id, timepoint, value, age_c, sex, mean_fd_c)
  
  n_subjects <- dat %>% distinct(study_id) %>% nrow()
  
  n_complete <- dat %>% count(study_id) %>% filter(n == 2) %>% nrow()
  if (n_complete < 5) {
    return(tibble(
      region = roi,
      n_subjects = n_subjects,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      beta_timepoint = NA_real_,
      t_value = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      singular = NA))}
  
  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint + age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1 | study_id), data = dat)
  
  model_out <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term == "timepointpost")
  
  tibble(region = roi,
    n_subjects = n_subjects,
    n_complete = n_complete,
    beta_timepoint = model_out$estimate,
    t_value = model_out$statistic,
    df = model_out$df,
    p_value = model_out$p.value,
    singular = lme4::isSingular(model))
}

rsfc_prepost_25_lmer_results <- map_dfr(roi_vars, run_prepost_rsfc_lmer) %>%
  mutate(pfdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% arrange(p_value)
```
###1.1.1 plot brain map
```{r}
glasser_atlas <- ggsegGlasser::glasser

brain_25_results <- rsfc_prepost_25_lmer_results %>%
  transmute(original_roi = region, t_value, p_value, pfdr,
            parcel = region %>% str_remove("^[LR]_") %>% str_remove("_ROI$"),
            label = case_when(str_detect(region, "^L_") ~ paste0("lh_L_", parcel),
                              str_detect(region, "^R_") ~ paste0("rh_R_", parcel), TRUE ~ NA_character_),
            significant = !is.na(pfdr) & pfdr < 0.05)

plot_data <- glasser_atlas$data %>% left_join(brain_25_results, by = "label")
t_limit <- max(abs(brain_25_results$t_value), na.rm = TRUE)

OverallChange_BA25 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = plot_data, aes(fill = t_value), colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf(data = plot_data %>% filter(significant), fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = plot_data %>% filter(str_detect(label, "25")),
          fill = "#008080", colour = "#008080", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-t_limit, t_limit),
                       na.value = "grey92", name = "t statistic") +
  labs(title = "Pre- to Post-Treatment rsFC Change",
       subtitle = "Cortical connectivity with sgACC",
       caption = "Black outline: pFDR < .05\nTeal: sgACC seed (BA25)") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

OverallChange_BA25

ggsave("OverallChange_BA25.png", plot = OverallChange_BA25, width = 10, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

###1.2.2 covariate for med and marker
```{r}
run_prepost_25_med <- function(roi) {
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
    select(study_id,timepoint,age,sex,mean_fd,value=all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(treatment_info,by="study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=c("pre","post")),
           actual_treatment=factor(actual_treatment,levels=c("SER","BUP")),sex=factor(sex),
           age_c=age-mean(age,na.rm=TRUE),mean_fd_c=mean_fd-mean(mean_fd,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id,timepoint,actual_treatment,value,age_c,sex,mean_fd_c)

  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint*actual_treatment +
                            age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1|study_id),data=dat)

  broom.mixed::tidy(model,effects="fixed") %>%
    filter(term=="timepointpost") %>%
    transmute(region=roi,beta_timepoint=estimate,t_value=statistic,df=df,p_value=p.value)
}

rsfc_prepost_25_med <- map_dfr(roi_vars,run_prepost_25_med) %>%
  mutate(pfdr=p.adjust(p_value,"BH")) %>% arrange(p_value)

run_prepost_25_marker <- function(roi) {
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
    select(study_id,timepoint,age,sex,mean_fd,value=all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(marker_info,by="study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=c("pre","post")),
           marker_treatment=factor(marker_treatment),sex=factor(sex),
           age_c=age-mean(age,na.rm=TRUE),mean_fd_c=mean_fd-mean(mean_fd,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id,timepoint,marker_treatment,value,age_c,sex,mean_fd_c)

  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint + marker_treatment +
                            age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1|study_id),data=dat)

  broom.mixed::tidy(model,effects="fixed") %>%
    filter(term=="timepointpost") %>%
    transmute(region=roi,beta_timepoint=estimate,t_value=statistic,df=df,p_value=p.value)
}

rsfc_prepost_25_marker <- map_dfr(roi_vars,run_prepost_25_marker) %>%
  mutate(pfdr=p.adjust(p_value,"BH")) %>% arrange(p_value)

rsfc_prepost_25_compare <- rsfc_prepost_25_lmer_results %>%
  select(region,beta_original=beta_timepoint,p_original=p_value,pfdr_original=pfdr) %>%
  left_join(rsfc_prepost_25_med %>%
    select(region,beta_med=beta_timepoint,p_med=p_value,pfdr_med=pfdr),by="region") %>%
  left_join(rsfc_prepost_25_marker %>%
    select(region,beta_marker=beta_timepoint,p_marker=p_value,pfdr_marker=pfdr),by="region") %>%
  arrange(pfdr_original)
```

##1.2 PeEC, EC, Hipp, Pres
```{r}
roi_vars_all <- names(smart_prepostrsfc_PeEC) %>%
  purrr::keep(~ grepl("_ROI$", .x)) %>%
  na.omit() %>%as.character()

length(roi_vars_all)
head(roi_vars_all)
tail(roi_vars_all)

roi_vars <- roi_vars_all[
  map_lgl(roi_vars_all, function(roi) {pre_values <- smart_prepostrsfc_PeEC %>%
      filter(timepoint == "pre") %>% pull(all_of(roi))
    post_values <- smart_prepostrsfc_PeEC %>%
      filter(timepoint == "post") %>% pull(all_of(roi))
    pre_has_data <- any(!is.na(pre_values))
    post_has_data <- any(!is.na(post_values))
    pre_has_data & post_has_data})]

roi_vars <- roi_vars[!is.na(roi_vars)]

length(roi_vars_all)
length(roi_vars)

removed_rois <- setdiff(roi_vars_all, roi_vars)

#linear mixed effect model
run_prepost_rsfc_lmer <- function(roi) {
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_PeEC %>%
    select(study_id, timepoint, age, sex, mean_fd, value = all_of(roi)) %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post")),
      sex = factor(sex),
      age_c = age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_fd_c = mean_fd - mean(mean_fd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id, timepoint, value, age_c, sex, mean_fd_c)
  
  n_subjects <- dat %>% distinct(study_id) %>% nrow()
  
  n_complete <- dat %>% count(study_id) %>% filter(n == 2) %>% nrow()
  if (n_complete < 5) {
    return(tibble(
      region = roi,
      n_subjects = n_subjects,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      beta_timepoint = NA_real_,
      t_value = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      singular = NA))}
  
  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint + age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1 | study_id), data = dat)
  
  model_out <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term == "timepointpost")
  
  tibble(region = roi,
    n_subjects = n_subjects,
    n_complete = n_complete,
    beta_timepoint = model_out$estimate,
    t_value = model_out$statistic,
    df = model_out$df,
    p_value = model_out$p.value,
    singular = lme4::isSingular(model))
}

rsfc_prepost_PeEC_lmer_results <- map_dfr(roi_vars, run_prepost_rsfc_lmer) %>%
  mutate(pfdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% arrange(p_value)
```
###1.2.1 plot brain map
```{r}
glasser_atlas <- ggsegGlasser::glasser

PeEC_brain_results <- rsfc_prepost_PeEC_lmer_results %>%
  transmute(original_roi = region, t_value, p_value, pfdr,
            parcel = region %>%
              str_remove("^[LR]_") %>% str_remove("_ROI$"),
            label = case_when(str_detect(region, "^L_") ~ paste0("lh_L_", parcel),
                              str_detect(region, "^R_") ~ paste0("rh_R_", parcel), TRUE ~ NA_character_),
            significant = !is.na(pfdr) & pfdr < 0.05)

matching_check <- PeEC_brain_results %>%
  mutate(matched = label %in% glasser_atlas$data$label)

matching_check %>% count(matched)

plot_data <- glasser_atlas$data %>%
  left_join(PeEC_brain_results, by = "label")

sig_labels <- plot_data %>% 
  filter(significant) %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
         y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2])

t_limit <- max(abs(PeEC_brain_results$t_value), na.rm = TRUE)

OverallChange_HippocampalFormation <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = plot_data, aes(fill = t_value), colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf(data = plot_data %>% filter(significant), fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = plot_data %>%
            filter(label %in% c("lh_L_EC", "rh_R_EC",
                                "lh_L_PreS", "rh_R_PreS",
                                "lh_L_PeEc", "rh_R_PeEc",
                                "lh_L_H", "rh_R_H")),
          fill = "#008080", colour = "#008080", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-t_limit, t_limit),
                       na.value = "grey92", name = "t statistic") +
  labs(title = "Pre- to Post-Treatment rsFC Change",
       subtitle = "Cortical connectivity with Hippocampal Formation",
       caption = "Black outline: pFDR < .05\nTeal: Hippocampal formation seed (EC, PreS, PeEc, H)") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

OverallChange_HippocampalFormation

ggsave("OverallChange_HippocampalFormation.png",
       plot = OverallChange_HippocampalFormation,
       width = 10, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
run_prepost_PeEC_med <- function(roi) {
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_PeEC %>%
    select(study_id,timepoint,age,sex,mean_fd,value=all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(treatment_info,by="study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=c("pre","post")),actual_treatment=factor(actual_treatment),
           sex=factor(sex),age_c=age-mean(age,na.rm=T),mean_fd_c=mean_fd-mean(mean_fd,na.rm=T)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id,timepoint,actual_treatment,value,age_c,sex,mean_fd_c)
  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint + actual_treatment + age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1|study_id),data=dat)
  broom.mixed::tidy(model,effects="fixed") %>% filter(term=="timepointpost") %>%
    transmute(region=roi,beta_timepoint=estimate,t_value=statistic,df=df,p_value=p.value)
}

run_prepost_PeEC_marker <- function(roi) {
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_PeEC %>%
    select(study_id,timepoint,age,sex,mean_fd,value=all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(marker_info,by="study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=c("pre","post")),marker_treatment=factor(marker_treatment),
           sex=factor(sex),age_c=age-mean(age,na.rm=T),mean_fd_c=mean_fd-mean(mean_fd,na.rm=T)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id,timepoint,marker_treatment,value,age_c,sex,mean_fd_c)
  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint + marker_treatment + age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1|study_id),data=dat)
  broom.mixed::tidy(model,effects="fixed") %>% filter(term=="timepointpost") %>%
    transmute(region=roi,beta_timepoint=estimate,t_value=statistic,df=df,p_value=p.value)
}

rsfc_prepost_PeEC_med <- map_dfr(roi_vars,run_prepost_PeEC_med) %>%
  mutate(pfdr=p.adjust(p_value,"BH")) %>% arrange(p_value)

rsfc_prepost_PeEC_marker <- map_dfr(roi_vars,run_prepost_PeEC_marker) %>%
  mutate(pfdr=p.adjust(p_value,"BH")) %>% arrange(p_value)

rsfc_prepost_PeEC_compare <- rsfc_prepost_PeEC_lmer_results %>%
  select(region,beta_original=beta_timepoint,p_original=p_value,pfdr_original=pfdr) %>%
  left_join(rsfc_prepost_PeEC_med %>% select(region,beta_med=beta_timepoint,p_med=p_value,pfdr_med=pfdr),by="region") %>%
  left_join(rsfc_prepost_PeEC_marker %>% select(region,beta_marker=beta_timepoint,p_marker=p_value,pfdr_marker=pfdr),by="region") %>%
  arrange(pfdr_original)
```

```{r}
    select(region,beta_marker=beta_timepoint,p_marker=p_value,pfdr_marker=pfdr),by="region") %>%
  arrange(pfdr_original)
```

```{r}
roi_vars_25 <- names(smart_prepostrsfc_25) %>%
  keep(~ str_detect(.x, "_ROI$")) %>%
  keep(~ {dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>% select(timepoint, value = all_of(.x))
    any(!is.na(dat$value[dat$timepoint == "pre"])) &&
      any(!is.na(dat$value[dat$timepoint == "post"]))})

run_25_responder_lmer <- function(roi) {
  
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
    select(study_id, timepoint, age, sex, mean_fd, value = all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(responder_info, by = "study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post")),
      sex = factor(sex),
      age_c = age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_fd_c = mean_fd - mean(mean_fd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id, timepoint, responder_status, value, age_c, sex, mean_fd_c)
  
  n_subjects <- n_distinct(dat$study_id)
  n_complete <- dat %>% count(study_id) %>% filter(n == 2) %>% nrow()
  
  if (n_complete < 8 || n_distinct(dat$responder_status) < 2) {
    return(tibble(region = roi, n_subjects, n_complete,
                  beta_interaction = NA_real_, t_value = NA_real_,
                  df = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_, singular = NA))}
  
  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint * responder_status + age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1 | study_id), data = dat)
  
  broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term == "timepointpost:responder_statusResponder") %>%
    transmute(
      region = roi,
      n_subjects = n_subjects,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      beta_interaction = estimate,
      t_value = statistic,
      df = df,
      p_value = p.value,
      singular = lme4::isSingular(model))}

rsfc_25_responder_change_results <- map_dfr(roi_vars_25, run_25_responder_lmer) %>%
  mutate(hemisphere = case_when(str_detect(region, "^L_") ~ "Left", str_detect(region, "^R_") ~ "Right", TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  group_by(hemisphere) %>%
  mutate(pfdr_hemi = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(hemisphere, p_value)
```

###2.1.4 post hoc
```{r}
roi_vars_25 <- names(smart_prepostrsfc_25) %>% str_subset("_ROI$")

responder_lookup <- responder_info %>%
  select(study_id, responder_status) %>%
  distinct(study_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

run_25_responder_posthoc <- function(roi) {

  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
    select(study_id, timepoint, age, sex, mean_fd, value = all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(responder_lookup, by = "study_id") %>%
    mutate(
      timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post")),
      responder_status = factor(responder_status,
        levels = c("Non-Responder", "Responder"),
        labels = c("Non-Responders", "Responders")),
      sex = factor(sex),
      age_c = age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_fd_c = mean_fd - mean(mean_fd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id, timepoint, responder_status, value, age_c, sex, mean_fd_c)

  if (n_distinct(interaction(dat$responder_status, dat$timepoint, drop = TRUE)) < 4)
    return(NULL)

  model <- lmer(value ~ timepoint * responder_status + age_c +
                  sex + mean_fd_c + (1 | study_id), data = dat)

  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ timepoint | responder_status)
  changes <- contrast(emm, "revpairwise") %>% summary() %>% as_tibble()
  interaction_test <- contrast(
    contrast(emm, "revpairwise"), "revpairwise", by = NULL) %>% summary() %>% as_tibble()

  changes %>%
    transmute(
      region = roi, responder_status,
      change = estimate, SE, df,
      t_within = t.ratio, p_within = p.value,
      interaction_estimate = interaction_test$estimate[1],
      t_interaction = interaction_test$t.ratio[1],
      p_interaction = interaction_test$p.value[1],
      n_subjects = n_distinct(dat$study_id)) %>%
    left_join(
      dat %>% distinct(study_id, responder_status) %>%
        count(responder_status, name = "n_group"),
      by = "responder_status")}

responder_25_posthoc_results <- map_dfr(roi_vars_25, run_25_responder_posthoc)

# Hemisphere-wise FDR: one interaction p-value per ROI
fdr_25 <- responder_25_posthoc_results %>%
  distinct(region, p_interaction) %>%
  mutate(hemisphere = str_extract(region, "^[LR]")) %>%
  group_by(hemisphere) %>%
  mutate(p_interaction_FDR = p.adjust(p_interaction, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(region, p_interaction_FDR)

responder_25_posthoc_results <- responder_25_posthoc_results %>%
  left_join(fdr_25, by = "region")

View(responder_25_posthoc_results)

rsfc_change_25 <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
  select(study_id, timepoint, all_of(roi_vars_25)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(roi_vars_25),
               names_to = "region", values_to = "rsfc") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = rsfc) %>%
  left_join(responder_lookup, by = "study_id") %>%
  mutate(
    change = post - pre,
    hemisphere = case_when(
      str_detect(region, "^R_") ~ "Right",
      str_detect(region, "^L_") ~ "Left"),
    reason = case_when(
      is.na(responder_status) ~ "Missing response status",
      is.na(pre) ~ "Missing pre rsFC",
      is.na(post) ~ "Missing post rsFC",
      change == 0 ~ "Zero change",
      TRUE ~ "Included"))

rsfc_complete_25 <- rsfc_change_25 %>%
  filter(reason == "Included") %>%
  mutate(direction = if_else(change > 0, "Increase", "Decrease"))

run_25_responder_fisher <- function(d) {

  tab <- table(
    factor(d$responder_status, levels = c("Responder", "Non-Responder")),
    factor(d$direction, levels = c("Increase", "Decrease")))

  if (any(rowSums(tab) == 0)) return(tibble())

  test <- fisher.test(tab)

  tibble(
    nonresponder_increase = unname(tab[2, 1]),
    nonresponder_decrease = unname(tab[2, 2]),
    responder_increase = unname(tab[1, 1]),
    responder_decrease = unname(tab[1, 2]),
    odds_ratio = unname(test$estimate),
    p_value = test$p.value)}

responder_25_fisher <- rsfc_complete_25 %>%
  group_by(region, hemisphere) %>%
  group_modify(~ run_25_responder_fisher(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(hemisphere) %>%
  mutate(p_FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

View(responder_25_fisher)

format_n_pct <- function(n, total)
  sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, 100 * n / total)

format_p <- function(p)
  ifelse(is.na(p), NA_character_,
         ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))

responder_25_fisher_table <- responder_25_fisher %>%
  mutate(
    nonresponder_n = nonresponder_increase + nonresponder_decrease,
    responder_n = responder_increase + responder_decrease,
    `Non-Responder Increase` = format_n_pct(nonresponder_increase, nonresponder_n),
    `Non-Responder Decrease` = format_n_pct(nonresponder_decrease, nonresponder_n),
    `Responder Increase` = format_n_pct(responder_increase, responder_n),
    `Responder Decrease` = format_n_pct(responder_decrease, responder_n),
    `Odds Ratio` = round(odds_ratio, 2),
    p = format_p(p_value),
    `FDR-adjusted p` = format_p(p_FDR)) %>%
  select(
    region, hemisphere,
    `Non-Responder Increase`, `Non-Responder Decrease`,
    `Responder Increase`, `Responder Decrease`,
    `Odds Ratio`, p, `FDR-adjusted p`)

responder_25_fisher_table

responder_25_posthoc <- responder_25_fisher_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Table X**"),
    subtitle = md("*Direction of Resting-State Functional Connectivity Change by Treatment Response Status*")
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Non-Responders",
    columns = c(`Non-Responder Increase`, `Non-Responder Decrease`)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Responders",
    columns = c(`Responder Increase`, `Responder Decrease`)
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    region = "Region",
    hemisphere = "Hemisphere",
    `Non-Responder Increase` = "Increase, n (%)",
    `Non-Responder Decrease` = "Decrease, n (%)",
    `Responder Increase` = "Increase, n (%)",
    `Responder Decrease` = "Decrease, n (%)",
    `Odds Ratio` = "OR",
    p = md("*p*"),
    `FDR-adjusted p` = md("*p* (FDR)")
  ) %>%
  cols_align("left", columns = c(region, hemisphere)) %>%
  cols_align("center", columns = -c(region, hemisphere)) %>%
  tab_source_note(md(
    "*Note.* Values represent the number and percentage of participants showing an increase or decrease in resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) from pre- to post-treatment. Change was calculated as post-treatment minus pre-treatment rsFC. Participants with zero change or missing measurements were excluded. Fisher's exact tests compared the distribution of increases versus decreases between responders and non-responders. OR = odds ratio for increased versus decreased rsFC in responders relative to non-responders. FDR correction was performed separately by hemisphere using the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure."))

responder_25_posthoc
gtsave(responder_25_posthoc, "responder_25_posthoc.rtf")
```

```{r}
      mean_fd_c = mean_fd - mean(mean_fd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id, timepoint, responder_status, value, age_c, sex, mean_fd_c)
  
  n_subjects <- n_distinct(dat$study_id)
  n_complete <- dat %>% count(study_id) %>% filter(n == 2) %>% nrow()
  
  if (n_complete < 8 || n_distinct(dat$responder_status) < 2) {
    return(tibble(region = roi, n_subjects, n_complete,
                  beta_interaction = NA_real_, t_value = NA_real_,
                  df = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_, singular = NA))}
  
  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint * responder_status + age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1 | study_id), data = dat)
  
  broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term == "timepointpost:responder_statusResponder") %>%
    transmute(
      region = roi,
      n_subjects = n_subjects,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      beta_interaction = estimate,
      t_value = statistic,
      p_value = p.value,
      singular = lme4::isSingular(model))}

PeEC_rsfc_responder_change_results <- map_dfr(roi_vars_PeEC, run_PeEC_responder_lmer) %>%
  mutate(hemisphere = case_when(str_detect(region, "^L_") ~ "Left", str_detect(region, "^R_") ~ "Right", TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  group_by(hemisphere) %>%
  mutate(pfdr_hemi = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
```

###2.3.1 post hoc
```{r}
run_a24p32_responder_posthoc <- function(roi) {
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_a24p32 %>%
    select(study_id, timepoint, age, sex, mean_fd, value = all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(responder_info %>% select(study_id, responder_status) %>% distinct(), by = "study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post")),
           responder_status = factor(responder_status, levels = c("Non-Responder", "Responder"),
                                     labels = c("Non-Responders", "Responders")),
           sex = factor(sex), age_c = age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
           mean_fd_c = mean_fd - mean(mean_fd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id, timepoint, responder_status, value, age_c, sex, mean_fd_c)

  if (nrow(distinct(dat, responder_status, timepoint)) < 4) return(NULL)

  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint * responder_status + age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1 | study_id), data = dat)
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(model, ~ timepoint | responder_status)
  changes <- emmeans::contrast(emm, "revpairwise") %>% summary() %>% as_tibble()
  interaction <- emmeans::contrast(emmeans::contrast(emm, "revpairwise"), "revpairwise", by = NULL) %>% summary()

  changes %>%
    transmute(region = roi, responder_status, change = estimate, SE, df,
              t_within = t.ratio, p_within = p.value,
              interaction_estimate = interaction$estimate[1],
              t_interaction = interaction$t.ratio[1],
              p_interaction = interaction$p.value[1],
              n_subjects = n_distinct(dat$study_id)) %>%
    left_join(dat %>% group_by(responder_status) %>%
                summarise(n_group = n_distinct(study_id), .groups = "drop"),
              by = "responder_status")
}

responder_a24p32_posthoc_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(smart_prepostrsfc_a24p32) %>% stringr::str_subset("_ROI$"),
  run_a24p32_responder_posthoc
)

      select(region, p_interaction_FDR),

##fishers exact
run_a24p32_responder_fisher <- function(roi) {

  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_a24p32 %>%
    select(study_id, timepoint, value = all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(responder_info %>% select(study_id, responder_status) %>% distinct(), by = "study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post")),
           responder_status = factor(responder_status, levels = c("Non-Responder", "Responder"))) %>%
    drop_na(study_id, timepoint, responder_status, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value) %>%
    drop_na(pre, post) %>%
    mutate(change = post - pre,
           direction = case_when(change > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                 change < 0 ~ "Decrease",
                                 TRUE ~ "No Change")) %>%
    filter(direction != "No Change")

  tab <- table(dat$responder_status, dat$direction)
  if (nrow(tab) < 2 || ncol(tab) < 2) return(NULL)

  ft <- fisher.test(tab)

  tibble(
    region = roi,
    nonresponder_increase = sum(dat$responder_status == "Non-Responder" & dat$direction == "Increase"),
    nonresponder_decrease = sum(dat$responder_status == "Non-Responder" & dat$direction == "Decrease"),
    responder_increase = sum(dat$responder_status == "Responder" & dat$direction == "Increase"),
    responder_decrease = sum(dat$responder_status == "Responder" & dat$direction == "Decrease"),
    odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate),
    p_value = ft$p.value
  )
}

significant_responder_rois <- a24p32_rsfc_responder_change_results %>%
  filter(pfdr_hemi < .05) %>% pull(region)

responder_a24p32_fisher <- map_dfr(significant_responder_rois, run_a24p32_responder_fisher) %>%
  mutate(hemisphere = case_when(
    str_detect(region, "^L_") ~ "Left",
    str_detect(region, "^R_") ~ "Right",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

responder_a24p32_fisher_table <- responder_a24p32_fisher %>%
  mutate(
    nonresponder_n = nonresponder_increase + nonresponder_decrease,
    responder_n = responder_increase + responder_decrease,
    `Non-Responder Increase` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", nonresponder_increase, 100*nonresponder_increase/nonresponder_n),
    `Non-Responder Decrease` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", nonresponder_decrease, 100*nonresponder_decrease/nonresponder_n),
    `Responder Increase` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", responder_increase, 100*responder_increase/responder_n),
    `Responder Decrease` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", responder_decrease, 100*responder_decrease/responder_n),
    OR = round(odds_ratio, 2),
    p = if_else(p_value < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", p_value))
  ) %>%
  select(region, hemisphere, `Non-Responder Increase`, `Non-Responder Decrease`,
         `Responder Increase`, `Responder Decrease`, OR, p)

responder_a24p32_fisher_table
```

```{r}
responder_plot_dat <- responder_a24p32_posthoc_results %>%
  filter(region %in% (a24p32_rsfc_responder_change_results %>%
                        filter(pfdr_hemi < .05) %>% pull(region))) %>%
  mutate(
    region_label = str_replace_all(str_remove(region, "_ROI$"), "_", " "),
    region_label = fct_reorder(region_label, change),
    y_pos = as.numeric(region_label) + ifelse(responder_status == "Responder", .2, -.2),
    ci_low = change - qt(.975, df) * SE,
    ci_high = change + qt(.975, df) * SE,
    p_label = ifelse(p_within < .001, "p < .001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_within)))

label_position <- max(responder_plot_dat$ci_high, na.rm = TRUE) + .3

ggplot(responder_plot_dat, aes(x = change, y = y_pos, color = responder_status)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high), height = .12) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = p_within < .05), size = 3.5, stroke = 1.2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 1), guide = "none") +
  geom_text(aes(x = label_position, label = p_label),
            hjust = 0, size = 4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(levels(responder_plot_dat$region_label)),

  scale_color_manual(values = c("Non-Responder" = "#FF5A5F", "Responder" = "#00AEB3")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min(responder_plot_dat$ci_low) - .4, label_position + 1.3)) +
  labs(title = "Pre-to-Post Change in pgACC Connectivity",

  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
```

```{r}
roi_vars_p24a32pr <- names(smart_prepostrsfc_p24a32pr) %>%
  keep(~ str_detect(.x, "_ROI$")) %>%
  keep(~ {dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_p24a32pr %>% select(timepoint, value = all_of(.x))
    any(!is.na(dat$value[dat$timepoint == "pre"])) &&
      any(!is.na(dat$value[dat$timepoint == "post"]))})

run_p24a32pr_responder_lmer <- function(roi) {
  
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_p24a32pr %>%
    select(study_id, timepoint, age, sex, mean_fd, value = all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(responder_info, by = "study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post")),
      sex = factor(sex),
      age_c = age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_fd_c = mean_fd - mean(mean_fd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id, timepoint, responder_status, value, age_c, sex, mean_fd_c)
  
  n_subjects <- n_distinct(dat$study_id)
  n_complete <- dat %>% count(study_id) %>% filter(n == 2) %>% nrow()
  
  if (n_complete < 8 || n_distinct(dat$responder_status) < 2) {
    return(tibble(region = roi, n_subjects, n_complete,
                  beta_interaction = NA_real_, t_value = NA_real_,
                  df = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_, singular = NA))}
  
  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint * responder_status + age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1 | study_id), data = dat)
  
  broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term == "timepointpost:responder_statusResponder") %>%
    transmute(
      region = roi,
      n_subjects = n_subjects,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      beta_interaction = estimate,
      t_value = statistic,
      df = df,
      p_value = p.value,
      singular = lme4::isSingular(model))}

p24a32pr_rsfc_responder_change_results <- map_dfr(roi_vars_p24a32pr, run_p24a32pr_responder_lmer) %>%
  mutate(hemisphere = case_when(str_detect(region, "^L_") ~ "Left", str_detect(region, "^R_") ~ "Right", TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  group_by(hemisphere) %>%
  mutate(pfdr_hemi = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(hemisphere, p_value)
```

###3.1.3 post hoc
```{r}
roi_vars_25 <- names(smart_prepostrsfc_25) %>% str_subset("_ROI$")
remission_lookup <- remission_info %>%
  select(study_id, remission_status) %>% distinct(study_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

run_25_remission_posthoc <- function(roi) {
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
    select(study_id, timepoint, age, sex, mean_fd, value = all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(remission_lookup, by = "study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post")),
           remission_status = factor(remission_status, levels = c("Non-Remitter", "Remitter")),
           sex = factor(sex), age_c = age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
           mean_fd_c = mean_fd - mean(mean_fd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id, timepoint, remission_status, value, age_c, sex, mean_fd_c)

  if (nrow(distinct(dat, remission_status, timepoint)) < 4) return(NULL)

  model <- lmer(value ~ timepoint * remission_status + age_c + sex +
                  mean_fd_c + (1 | study_id), data = dat)
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ timepoint | remission_status)
  changes <- summary(contrast(emm, "revpairwise")) %>% as_tibble()
  interaction_test <- summary(contrast(
    contrast(emm, "revpairwise"), "revpairwise", by = NULL))

  changes %>%
    transmute(region = roi, remission_status, change = estimate, SE, df,
              t_within = t.ratio, p_within = p.value,
              interaction_estimate = interaction_test$estimate[1],
              t_interaction = interaction_test$t.ratio[1],
              p_interaction = interaction_test$p.value[1],
              n_subjects = n_distinct(dat$study_id),
              singular = lme4::isSingular(model)) %>%
    left_join(dat %>% distinct(study_id, remission_status) %>%
                count(remission_status, name = "n_group"), by = "remission_status")}

remission_25_posthoc_results <- map_dfr(roi_vars_25, run_25_remission_posthoc) %>%
  mutate(hemisphere = str_extract(region, "^[LR]")) %>%
  left_join(
    distinct(., region, hemisphere, p_interaction) %>%
      group_by(hemisphere) %>%
      mutate(p_interaction_FDR = p.adjust(p_interaction, "BH")) %>%
      ungroup() %>% select(region, p_interaction_FDR),
    by = "region") %>%
  mutate(hemisphere = recode(hemisphere, L = "Left", R = "Right")) %>%
  arrange(region, remission_status)

View(remission_25_posthoc_results)

rsfc_remission_25 <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
  select(study_id, timepoint, all_of(roi_vars_25)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(roi_vars_25), names_to = "region", values_to = "rsfc") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = rsfc) %>%
  left_join(remission_lookup, by = "study_id") %>%
  mutate(change = post - pre,
         hemisphere = recode(str_extract(region, "^[LR]"), L = "Left", R = "Right"),
         reason = case_when(
           is.na(remission_status) ~ "Missing remission status",
           is.na(pre) ~ "Missing pre rsFC",
           is.na(post) ~ "Missing post rsFC",
           change == 0 ~ "Zero change",
           TRUE ~ "Included"))

rsfc_remission_complete_25 <- rsfc_remission_25 %>%
  filter(reason == "Included") %>%
  mutate(direction = if_else(change > 0, "Increase", "Decrease"))

significant_remission_rois <- rsfc_25_remission_change_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(pfdr_hemi), pfdr_hemi < .05) %>%
  pull(region) %>% unique()

run_25_remission_fisher <- function(d) {
  tab <- table(
    factor(d$remission_status, levels = c("Remitter", "Non-Remitter")),
    factor(d$direction, levels = c("Increase", "Decrease")))
  if (any(rowSums(tab) == 0)) return(tibble())

  ft <- fisher.test(tab)
  tibble(nonremitter_increase = unname(tab[2, 1]),
         nonremitter_decrease = unname(tab[2, 2]),
         remitter_increase = unname(tab[1, 1]),
         remitter_decrease = unname(tab[1, 2]),
         odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate), p_value = ft$p.value)}

remission_25_fisher <- rsfc_remission_complete_25 %>%
  filter(region %in% significant_remission_rois) %>%
  group_by(region, hemisphere) %>%
  group_modify(~ run_25_remission_fisher(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()

format_n_pct <- function(n, total) sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, 100 * n / total)
format_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", p))

remission_25_fisher_table <- remission_25_fisher %>%
  mutate(
    nonremitter_n = nonremitter_increase + nonremitter_decrease,
    remitter_n = remitter_increase + remitter_decrease,
    `Non-Remitter Increase` = format_n_pct(nonremitter_increase, nonremitter_n),
    `Non-Remitter Decrease` = format_n_pct(nonremitter_decrease, nonremitter_n),
    `Remitter Increase` = format_n_pct(remitter_increase, remitter_n),
    `Remitter Decrease` = format_n_pct(remitter_decrease, remitter_n),
    OR = round(odds_ratio, 2), p = format_p(p_value)) %>%
  select(region, hemisphere, `Non-Remitter Increase`, `Non-Remitter Decrease`,
         `Remitter Increase`, `Remitter Decrease`, OR, p)

remission_25_fisher_table

remission_25_posthoc <- remission_25_fisher_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Table X**"),
             subtitle = md("*Direction of Resting-State Functional Connectivity Change by Remission Status*")) %>%
  tab_spanner("Non-Remitters", columns = c(`Non-Remitter Increase`, `Non-Remitter Decrease`)) %>%
  tab_spanner("Remitters", columns = c(`Remitter Increase`, `Remitter Decrease`)) %>%
  cols_label(region = "Region", hemisphere = "Hemisphere",
             `Non-Remitter Increase` = "Increase, n (%)",
             `Non-Remitter Decrease` = "Decrease, n (%)",
             `Remitter Increase` = "Increase, n (%)",
             `Remitter Decrease` = "Decrease, n (%)",
             OR = "OR", p = md("*p*")) %>%
  cols_align("left", columns = c(region, hemisphere)) %>%
  cols_align("center", columns = -c(region, hemisphere)) %>%
  tab_source_note(md(
    "*Note.* Values represent participants with increased or decreased rsFC from pre- to post-treatment. Zero changes and missing observations were excluded. Fisher's exact tests compared the direction of rsFC change between remitters and non-remitters. OR = odds ratio for increased versus decreased rsFC in remitters relative to non-remitters."))

gtsave(remission_25_posthoc, "remission_25_posthoc.rtf")
```

```{r}
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
    select(study_id,timepoint,age,sex,mean_fd,value=all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(remission_info,by="study_id") %>% left_join(treatment_info,by="study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=c("pre","post")),
           remission_status=factor(remission_status,levels=c("Non-Remitter","Remitter")),
           actual_treatment=factor(actual_treatment,levels=c("SER","BUP")),sex=factor(sex),
           age_c=age-mean(age,na.rm=TRUE),mean_fd_c=mean_fd-mean(mean_fd,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id,timepoint,remission_status,actual_treatment,value,age_c,sex,mean_fd_c)
```

```{r}
roi_vars_PeEC <- names(smart_prepostrsfc_PeEC) %>%
  keep(~ str_detect(.x, "_ROI$")) %>%
  keep(~ {dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_PeEC %>% select(timepoint, value = all_of(.x))
    any(!is.na(dat$value[dat$timepoint == "pre"])) &&
      any(!is.na(dat$value[dat$timepoint == "post"]))})

run_PeEC_remission_lmer <- function(roi) {
  
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_PeEC %>%
    select(study_id, timepoint, age, sex, mean_fd, value = all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(remission_info, by = "study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post")),
      sex = factor(sex),
      age_c = age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_fd_c = mean_fd - mean(mean_fd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id, timepoint, remission_status, value, age_c, sex, mean_fd_c)
  
  n_subjects <- n_distinct(dat$study_id)
  n_complete <- dat %>% count(study_id) %>% filter(n == 2) %>% nrow()
  
  if (n_complete < 8 || n_distinct(dat$remission_status) < 2) {
    return(tibble(region = roi, n_subjects, n_complete,
                  beta_interaction = NA_real_, t_value = NA_real_,
                  df = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_, singular = NA))}
  
  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint * remission_status + age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1 | study_id), data = dat)
  
  broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term == "timepointpost:remission_statusRemitter") %>%
    transmute(
      region = roi,
      n_subjects = n_subjects,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      beta_interaction = estimate,
      t_value = statistic,
      df = df,
      p_value = p.value,
      singular = lme4::isSingular(model))}

  group_by(hemisphere) %>%
  mutate(pfdr_hemi = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(hemisphere, p_value)
```

#4.madrs change with rsfc
##4.1 25
```{r}
run_25_percent_change_lmer <- function(roi) {

  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
    select(study_id,timepoint,age,sex,mean_fd,value = all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(remission_info %>% select(study_id, percent_change), by = "study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post")),
           sex = factor(sex),
           age_c = age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
           mean_fd_c = mean_fd - mean(mean_fd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id,timepoint,percent_change,value,age_c,sex,mean_fd_c)
  n_subjects <- n_distinct(dat$study_id)
  n_complete <- dat %>%
    distinct(study_id, timepoint) %>%
    count(study_id) %>%
    filter(n == 2) %>%
    nrow()
  if (n_complete < 8) {
    return(tibble(region = roi,
        n_subjects = n_subjects,
        n_complete = n_complete,
        beta_interaction = NA_real_,
        t_value = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        singular = NA))}

  model <- lmerTest::lmer( value ~ timepoint * percent_change + age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1 | study_id), data = dat)

  model_out <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term == "timepointpost:percent_change")

  if (nrow(model_out) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
        region = roi,
        n_subjects = n_subjects,
        n_complete = n_complete,
        beta_interaction = NA_real_,
        t_value = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        singular = lme4::isSingular(model)))}

  model_out %>%
    transmute(region = roi,
      n_subjects = n_subjects,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      beta_interaction = estimate,
      t_value = statistic,
      df = df,
      p_value = p.value,
      singular = lme4::isSingular(model))
}

rsfc_25_percent_change_results <- map_dfr(roi_vars_25,run_25_percent_change_lmer) %>%
  mutate(hemisphere = case_when(str_detect(region, "^L_") ~ "Left", str_detect(region, "^R_") ~ "Right", TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  group_by(hemisphere) %>%
  mutate(pfdr_hemi = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(hemisphere, p_value)
```

```{r}
make_scatter_25 <- function(roi) {
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
    select(study_id,timepoint,value=all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(remission_info %>% select(study_id,percent_change) %>% distinct(study_id,.keep_all=TRUE), by="study_id") %>%
    drop_na(value,percent_change) %>% pivot_wider(names_from=timepoint,values_from=value) %>%
    mutate(rsfc_change=post-pre) %>% drop_na(rsfc_change)

  ggplot(dat,aes(percent_change,rsfc_change)) +
    geom_point(size=2.5,alpha=.7) + geom_smooth(method="lm",se=TRUE,linewidth=1) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text=element_text(size=14),axis.title=element_text(size=14),
          plot.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold",hjust=.5)) +
    labs(title=roi %>% str_remove("_ROI$") %>% str_replace("^R_","Right ") %>% str_replace("^L_","Left "),
         x="MADRS reduction (%)",y="Pre-to-post rsFC change")
```

```{r}
run_25_percent_change_med <- function(roi) {
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_25 %>%
    select(study_id,timepoint,age,sex,mean_fd,value=all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(remission_info %>% select(study_id,percent_change),by="study_id") %>%
    left_join(treatment_info,by="study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=c("pre","post")),
           actual_treatment=factor(actual_treatment,levels=c("SER","BUP")),sex=factor(sex),
           age_c=age-mean(age,na.rm=TRUE),mean_fd_c=mean_fd-mean(mean_fd,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id,timepoint,percent_change,actual_treatment,value,age_c,sex,mean_fd_c)

  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint*percent_change + timepoint*actual_treatment +
                            age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1|study_id),data=dat)

  broom.mixed::tidy(model,effects="fixed") %>%
    filter(term=="timepointpost:percent_change") %>%
    transmute(region=roi,beta_interaction=estimate,t_value=statistic,df=df,p_value=p.value)
}

  group_by(hemisphere) %>% mutate(pfdr_hemi=p.adjust(p_value,"BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>% arrange(hemisphere,p_value)

  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint*percent_change + marker_treatment +
                            age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1|study_id),data=dat)

  broom.mixed::tidy(model,effects="fixed") %>%
    filter(term=="timepointpost:percent_change") %>%
    transmute(region=roi,beta_interaction=estimate,t_value=statistic,df=df,p_value=p.value)
}
```

##4.2 PeEC, EC, Hipp, Pres
```{r}
roi_vars_PeEC <- names(smart_prepostrsfc_PeEC) %>%
  keep(~ str_detect(.x, "_ROI$")) %>%
  keep(~ {dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_p24a32pr %>% select(timepoint, value = all_of(.x))
    any(!is.na(dat$value[dat$timepoint == "pre"])) &&
      any(!is.na(dat$value[dat$timepoint == "post"]))})

run_PeEC_percent_change_lmer <- function(roi) {

  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_PeEC %>%
    select(study_id,timepoint,age,sex,mean_fd,value = all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(remission_info %>% select(study_id, percent_change), by = "study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post")),
           sex = factor(sex),
           age_c = age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
           mean_fd_c = mean_fd - mean(mean_fd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id,timepoint,percent_change,value,age_c,sex,mean_fd_c)
  n_subjects <- n_distinct(dat$study_id)
  n_complete <- dat %>%
    distinct(study_id, timepoint) %>%
    count(study_id) %>%
    filter(n == 2) %>%
    nrow()
  if (n_complete < 8) {
    return(tibble(region = roi,
        n_subjects = n_subjects,
        n_complete = n_complete,
        beta_interaction = NA_real_,
        t_value = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        singular = NA))}

  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint * percent_change + age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1 | study_id), data = dat)

  model_out <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term == "timepointpost:percent_change")

  if (nrow(model_out) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
        region = roi,
        n_subjects = n_subjects,
        n_complete = n_complete,
        beta_interaction = NA_real_,
        t_value = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        singular = lme4::isSingular(model)))}

  model_out %>%
    transmute(region = roi,
      n_subjects = n_subjects,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      beta_interaction = estimate,
      t_value = statistic,
      df = df,
      p_value = p.value,
      singular = lme4::isSingular(model))
}

rsfc_PeEC_percent_change_results <- map_dfr(roi_vars_PeEC,run_PeEC_percent_change_lmer) %>%
  mutate(hemisphere = case_when(str_detect(region, "^L_") ~ "Left", str_detect(region, "^R_") ~ "Right", TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  group_by(hemisphere) %>%
  mutate(pfdr_hemi = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(hemisphere, p_value)
```

```{r}
    drop_na(study_id,timepoint,percent_change,value,age_c,sex,mean_fd_c)
  n_subjects <- n_distinct(dat$study_id)
  n_complete <- dat %>%
    distinct(study_id, timepoint) %>%
    count(study_id) %>%
    filter(n == 2) %>%
    nrow()
  if (n_complete < 8) {
    return(tibble(region = roi,
        n_subjects = n_subjects,
        n_complete = n_complete,
        beta_interaction = NA_real_,
        t_value = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        singular = NA))}

  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint * percent_change + age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1 | study_id), data = dat)

  model_out <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term == "timepointpost:percent_change")

  if (nrow(model_out) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
        region = roi,
        n_subjects = n_subjects,
        n_complete = n_complete,
        beta_interaction = NA_real_,
        t_value = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        singular = lme4::isSingular(model)))}

  model_out %>%
    transmute(region = roi,
      n_subjects = n_subjects,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      beta_interaction = estimate,
      t_value = statistic,
      df = df,
      p_value = p.value,
      singular = lme4::isSingular(model))
}

rsfc_p24a32pr_percent_change_results <- map_dfr(roi_vars_p24a32pr,run_p24a32pr_percent_change_lmer) %>%
  mutate(hemisphere = case_when(str_detect(region, "^L_") ~ "Left", str_detect(region, "^R_") ~ "Right", TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  group_by(hemisphere) %>%
  mutate(pfdr_hemi = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(hemisphere, p_value)
```
###4.4.1 covariate for med and marker
```{r}
run_p24a32pr_percent_change_med <- function(roi) {
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_p24a32pr %>%
    select(study_id,timepoint,age,sex,mean_fd,value=all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(remission_info %>% select(study_id,percent_change),by="study_id") %>%
    left_join(treatment_info,by="study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=c("pre","post")),
           actual_treatment=factor(actual_treatment,levels=c("SER","BUP")),sex=factor(sex),
           age_c=age-mean(age,na.rm=TRUE),mean_fd_c=mean_fd-mean(mean_fd,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id,timepoint,percent_change,actual_treatment,value,age_c,sex,mean_fd_c)

  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint*percent_change + timepoint*actual_treatment +
                            age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1|study_id),data=dat)

  broom.mixed::tidy(model,effects="fixed") %>%
    filter(term=="timepointpost:percent_change") %>%
    transmute(region=roi,beta_interaction=estimate,t_value=statistic,df=df,p_value=p.value)
}

rsfc_p24a32pr_percent_change_med <- map_dfr(roi_vars_p24a32pr,run_p24a32pr_percent_change_med) %>%
  mutate(hemisphere=case_when(str_detect(region,"^L_")~"Left",
                              str_detect(region,"^R_")~"Right",TRUE~"Other")) %>%
  group_by(hemisphere) %>% mutate(pfdr_hemi=p.adjust(p_value,"BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>% arrange(hemisphere,p_value)

run_p24a32pr_percent_change_marker <- function(roi) {
  dat <- smart_prepostrsfc_p24a32pr %>%
    select(study_id,timepoint,age,sex,mean_fd,value=all_of(roi)) %>%
    left_join(remission_info %>% select(study_id,percent_change),by="study_id") %>%
    left_join(marker_info,by="study_id") %>%
    mutate(timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=c("pre","post")),
           marker_treatment=factor(marker_treatment),sex=factor(sex),
           age_c=age-mean(age,na.rm=TRUE),mean_fd_c=mean_fd-mean(mean_fd,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(study_id,timepoint,percent_change,marker_treatment,value,age_c,sex,mean_fd_c)

  model <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ timepoint*percent_change + marker_treatment +
                            age_c + sex + mean_fd_c + (1|study_id),data=dat)

  broom.mixed::tidy(model,effects="fixed") %>%
    filter(term=="timepointpost:percent_change") %>%
    transmute(region=roi,beta_interaction=estimate,t_value=statistic,df=df,p_value=p.value)
}

rsfc_p24a32pr_percent_change_marker <- map_dfr(roi_vars_p24a32pr,run_p24a32pr_percent_change_marker) %>%

                              str_detect(region,"^R_")~"Right",TRUE~"Other")) %>%

  ungroup() %>% arrange(hemisphere,p_value)

rsfc_p24a32pr_percent_change_compare <- rsfc_p24a32pr_percent_change_results %>%
  select(region,beta_original=beta_interaction,p_original=p_value,pfdr_original=pfdr_hemi) %>%
  left_join(rsfc_p24a32pr_percent_change_med %>%
    select(region,beta_med=beta_interaction,p_med=p_value,pfdr_med=pfdr_hemi),by="region") %>%
  left_join(rsfc_p24a32pr_percent_change_marker %>%
    select(region,beta_marker=beta_interaction,p_marker=p_value,pfdr_marker=pfdr_hemi),by="region") %>%
```

#supplementary table - sensitivity analysis
```{r}
comparisons <- list(
  "Pre-post" = list(
    sgACC = rsfc_prepost_25_compare,
    pgACC = rsfc_prepost_a24p32_compare,
    dACC = rsfc_prepost_p24a32pr_compare,
    "Hippocampal formation" = rsfc_prepost_PeEC_compare),
  "Response" = list(
    sgACC = rsfc_25_responder_change_withmarker_compare,
    pgACC = a24p32_rsfc_responder_change_withmarker_compare,
    dACC = rsfc_p24a32pr_responder_change_withmarker_compare,
    "Hippocampal formation" = PeEC_rsfc_responder_compare),
  "Remission" = list(
    sgACC = rsfc_25_remission_withmarker_compare,
    pgACC = a24p32_rsfc_remission_compare,
    dACC = p24a32pr_rsfc_remission_compare,
    "Hippocampal formation" = PeEC_rsfc_remission_compare),
  "MADRS change" = list(
    sgACC = rsfc_25_percent_change_compare,
    pgACC = rsfc_a24p32_percent_change_compare,
    dACC = rsfc_p24a32pr_percent_change_compare,
    "Hippocampal formation" = rsfc_PeEC_percent_compare))

sensitivity_table <- imap_dfr(comparisons, \(seeds, analysis)
  imap_dfr(seeds, \(x, seed)
    x %>% ungroup() %>%
      transmute(
        Analysis = analysis, Seed = seed, Region = region,
        `Original β` = beta_original, `Original pFDR` = pfdr_original,
        `Medication β` = beta_med, `Medication pFDR` = pfdr_med,
        `Marker β` = beta_marker, `Marker pFDR` = pfdr_marker))) %>%
  filter(if_any(contains("pFDR"), ~ !is.na(.x) & .x < .05)) %>%
  arrange(Analysis, Seed, `Original pFDR`)

note <- paste(
  "Note. Regions surviving FDR correction (pFDR < .05) in at least one model",
  "are shown. Medication received and marker assignment (BUP, SER, Both,",
  "or Neither) were examined separately. No significant effects were",
  "observed for the hippocampal formation.")

supp_table <- sensitivity_table %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Analysis") %>%
  tab_spanner("Primary Model", c(`Original β`, `Original pFDR`)) %>%
  tab_spanner("Medication-Adjusted", c(`Medication β`, `Medication pFDR`)) %>%
  tab_spanner("Marker-Adjusted", c(`Marker β`, `Marker pFDR`)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(contains("β"), contains("pFDR")), decimals = 3) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Supplementary Table X**"),
    subtitle = "Sensitivity analyses adjusting for medication received and marker assignment") %>%
  tab_source_note(md(note))

supp_table

tab <- sensitivity_table %>%
  mutate(Region = gsub("_", " ", sub("_ROI$", "", Region))) %>%
  mutate(across(c(contains("β"), contains("pFDR")), ~ round(.x, 3)))

ft <- flextable(tab) %>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", "", "", "Primary Model", "Medication-Adjusted", "Marker-Adjusted"),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2)) %>%
  set_header_labels(values = setNames(
    rep(c("β", "pFDR"), 3), names(tab)[4:9])) %>%
  merge_v(j = "Analysis") %>%
  valign(j = "Analysis", valign = "top") %>%
  align(j = 1:3, align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = 4:9, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding = 3, part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  autofit()

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("Supplementary Table X", style = "heading 1") %>%
  body_add_par(
    "Sensitivity analyses adjusting for medication received and marker assignment") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft) %>%
  body_add_par(note) %>%
  body_set_default_section(value = prop_section(
    page_size = page_size(orient = "landscape"),
    page_margins = page_mar(top = .5, bottom = .5, left = .5, right = .5)))

print(doc, target = "~/Desktop/Supplementary_Table_X.docx")
```
